title: One named reason something is not permitted
description: SECTION 7. Source: src/box/operationalReadiness.ts ReadinessBlocker. The `scope` field is the whole point: it is what makes it STRUCTURALLY impossible for an entry-only restriction to block a reduction of exposure already owned. A blocker is a bounded, operator-readable sentence plus a stable machine code — never a stack trace, never SQL, never a secret.

code.description: Stable snake_case machine code, for the UI to key and group on. Never localised, never free text.

scope.description: entry = may stop creating NEW exposure ONLY, and can never reach the reduction verdict. reduction = genuinely prevents REDUCING exposure (an expired session; no priceable book) — rare and serious, because it means a live position cannot be closed right now. both = a fact that really does stop everything.

detail.description: One bounded sentence a human can act on. Safe to display verbatim.
